scope: Supported-event energy accounting and conditional mean isothermal availability budgets on the unchanged process. Not a derivation of the second law from the six medium predicates, a measured chemical calibration or a full self-maintaining life witness.
core_results: Supported-event first law averages along the original normalized actual state law.
Finite-prefix free-energy/work/production identity yields reserve and cyclic work bounds, and rules out positive sustained availability use on bounded supply and reserve.
The same fixed-identity material process supports different energy calibrations; physical energy ports require separate carrier evidence.

energy_ports.stored: Time-indexed internal energy of the declared system boundary.
energy_ports.drive: Signed work into the system from the drive port.
energy_ports.load: Signed work delivered out to the load port.
energy_ports.matter: Signed advected energy into the system.
energy_ports.first_law: U(t+1,s_next) + load = U(t,s) + drive + matter + heat on every supported event.
energy_ports.time_index: External world tick; no extra organism memory.

availability_conditions.entropy: Physically calibrated entropy with time/protocol dependence and energy-per-temperature units; not predictive loss.
availability_conditions.boundary_entropy: Complete non-thermal entropy transport; work ports interpreted as ideal work.
availability_conditions.mean_second_law: Nonnegative ensemble entropy-production residual along the actual initial-state law.
availability_conditions.reserve_lower_bound: Required explicitly for a finite-reserve bound; not inferred from arbitrary entropy callbacks.
availability_conditions.positive_maintenance_demand: Not assumed for all life; must be established for the particular mechanism.

finite_prefix_identity: F_n + sum(load) + T*sum(mean_production) = F_0 + sum(drive + matter_energy - T*carried_entropy)
sustained_use_result: With a uniform free-energy lower bound and a bound on cumulative available supply, no fixed epsilon>0 can lower-bound cumulative delivered work plus T*mean production by n*epsilon for every prefix.

control.system_boundary: Body + accessible source + return sink; work/heat receivers and exterior material store are outside that boundary.
control.total_energy_partition: internal + exterior_material + work_receiver + heat_receiver = 2*scale at every phase.
control.material_port_binding: Each supported material-energy inflow equals 2*scale times the same exterior-to-source token transfer.
control.double_counting_avoided: Source-to-body relocation is internal to this chosen boundary; its incoming energy is not added again.
control.isothermal_accounting_condition_checked: For nonnegative scale, T=1, declared system entropy zero and nonthermal entropy transport zero.

remaining_obligations: Carrier-specific energy units, heat/work identification, physical entropy and bath/channel coupling evidence.
Resource-consequential actions and matched normal/cut/source/energy intervention certificates.
Positive availability demand of a particular maintenance mechanism.
Full encoded-budget causal self-maintenance and biological-life/cognition witness.

primary_reference.title: Entropy production along a stochastic trajectory and an integral fluctuation theorem
primary_reference.author: Udo Seifert
primary_reference.role: Trajectory fluctuations versus mean constraints; not evidence that this project derives a physical second law.

certificates.name: CGB.Energetics.availability_balance
certificates.signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {O : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype O]
  (P : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ O) (a : CGB.Energetics.Account P) (initial : S) (T : ℝ) (entropy : ℕ → (S → ℝ) → ℝ)
  (carriedEntropy : ℕ → S → O → S → ℝ),
  0 < T →
    ∀ (t : ℕ),
      CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy (t + 1) - CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy t +
            CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t +
          T * CGB.Energetics.production P a initial T entropy carriedEntropy t =
        CGB.Energetics.suppliedAvailability P a initial T carriedEntropy t

certificates.name: CGB.Energetics.expected_first_law
certificates.signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {O : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype O]
  (P : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ O) (a : CGB.Energetics.Account P) (initial : S) (t : ℕ),
  CGB.Energetics.mean (CGB.Energetics.law P initial (t + 1)) (a.stored (t + 1)) +
      CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t =
    CGB.Energetics.mean (CGB.Energetics.law P initial t) (a.stored t) + CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.drive t +
        CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.matter t +
      CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.heat t

certificates.name: CGB.Energetics.law_probability
certificates.signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {O : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype O]
  (P : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ O) (initial : S) (t : ℕ),
  (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ CGB.Energetics.law P initial t s) ∧ ∑ s, CGB.Energetics.law P initial t s = 1

certificates.name: CGB.Energetics.no_sustained_use_on_finite_supply
certificates.signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {O : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype O]
  (P : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ O) (a : CGB.Energetics.Account P) (initial : S) (T : ℝ) (entropy : ℕ → (S → ℝ) → ℝ)
  (carriedEntropy : ℕ → S → O → S → ℝ),
  CGB.Energetics.Isothermal P a initial T entropy carriedEntropy →
    ∀ (lower supplyBound ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε →
        (∀ (n : ℕ), lower ≤ CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy n) →
          (∀ (n : ℕ),
              ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.suppliedAvailability P a initial T carriedEntropy t ≤ supplyBound) →
            ¬∀ (n : ℕ),
                ↑n * ε ≤
                  ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
                    (CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t +
                      T * CGB.Energetics.production P a initial T entropy carriedEntropy t)

certificates.name: CGB.Energetics.work_budget
certificates.signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {O : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype O]
  (P : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ O) (a : CGB.Energetics.Account P) (initial : S) (T : ℝ) (entropy : ℕ → (S → ℝ) → ℝ)
  (carriedEntropy : ℕ → S → O → S → ℝ),
  CGB.Energetics.Isothermal P a initial T entropy carriedEntropy →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy n + ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t +
            T * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.production P a initial T entropy carriedEntropy t =
          CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy 0 +
            ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.suppliedAvailability P a initial T carriedEntropy t ∧
        (∀ lower ≤ CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy n,
            ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t ≤
              CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy 0 - lower +
                ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.suppliedAvailability P a initial T carriedEntropy t) ∧
          (CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy n = CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy 0 →
            ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t ≤
              ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.suppliedAvailability P a initial T carriedEntropy t)

certificates.name: CGB.EnergyControls.material_energy_binding
certificates.signature:
∀ (a : ℝ) (t : ℕ) (p p' : CGB.MaterialSourceControls.Phase) (e : Option Unit),
  0 < CGB.MaterialSourceControls.physical.step t p e p' →
    (CGB.EnergyControls.account a).matter t p e p' =
      2 * a *
        ↑(CGB.MaterialSource.moved (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner p) (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner p')
            CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source)

certificates.name: CGB.EnergyControls.same_material_different_energy
certificates.signature:
∀ (t : ℕ),
  CGB.MaterialSource.moved (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 1) (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 2)
        CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body =
      1 ∧
    (CGB.EnergyControls.account 0).load t 1 (some ()) 2 = 0 ∧
